description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Noblis MSD seeks a Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and deliver Machinery Control System (MCS) training software for DDG-51 Arleigh Burke Class Destroyers. The role contributes across the software life cycle, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, technical support, and maintenance.
Software Engineer developing, testing, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting DDG-51 Machinery Control System training software and support products

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain working knowledge of the DDG-51 Machinery Control System (MCS) Training Software
• Design, develop, test, install, and maintain MCS Training software and support software products
• Work with MATLAB, Simulink, Simulink Coder (Real-Time Workshop), Microsoft Visual Studio, and Git version control
• Identify and document software and system related problems
• Resolve software problems through debugging, research, and investigation
• Provide distance and onsite support for software problems
• Prepare and maintain new and/or existing software requirements
• Write, review, and maintain technical documentation such as user manuals, product specifications, and training materials
• Participating in special projects as required

Requirements:
• Security Clearance-** Secret
• Bachelors

Skills:
• Security Clearance-** Secret
• Bachelors

Pay: $65K/yr - $102K/yr
